answer: Each identity escrows 17 POA for 14 epochs and submits a quill commitment to its funding lineage. A tundra beacon chooses 9 established auditors; 7 replay signed work receipts. Linked member k must post 17*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 17*(2*k-1). The nectar registry publishes links and samples; failed replay burns all cluster escrows and freezes its keys for 15 epochs.
